question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

The NCERT __was set up ahead__ by the government to assist and advise the Central and State Governments on policies and programmes for qualitative improvement in school education.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'was set up'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The underlined segment in the given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'was set up' **should be used instead of 'wa
